review.shorterRoute: Use the proved all-weight integral cusp spanning theorem only at weights 12*m. Divide each actual integral cusp generator by the actual integral discriminant power of the same weight, then use linearity and field scalar closure. A subsequent actual product with the discriminant converts arbitrary modular ratios to this case. No new rational basis, bounded-denominator proof, coefficient field or replacement complex function field is introduced.
